# snbench sample snapshots

Four files copied unchanged from `jacebenson/snbench` results on 2026-11-23:
`1tey` (one-task oracle), `8tvl` (34-task Qwen agent), `cpsd` (34-task
DeepSeek agent), and `aamb` (one failed DeepSeek task).

`synthetic-nop.json` is a synthetic negative-control fixture derived from the
oracle structure, with an explicit failing check and zero measurements. It is
NOT a measured nop run. The local source results directory had no nop run.
The pages label this fixture; do not publish it as measured benchmark evidence.

These are a curated development/test sample, not the full benchmark history.
Import real results for public publication. Fixtures are never auto-seeded.
